title: Cash Card Process Assessment – Prototype Kit
description: A single access point for interactive prototypes from the Cash Card Process Assessment.

prototypes.name: Northstar Account Console · Card Diagnostics
prototypes.description: Account console simulation with a guided card diagnostic assessment, supporting evidence, and advocate actions.
prototypes.problem: Advocates need a clear, consistent way to investigate card concerns and understand the facts behind a recommended action.
prototypes.notes: Uses the existing GitHub Pages deployment, preserving the original prototype repository as the source of truth.

prototypes.name: Cash App Card · Mobile Experience
prototypes.description: Interactive customer-facing card experience for activation, card controls, replacement, delivery, and related card journeys.
prototypes.problem: Customers need self-service guidance for common Cash Card lifecycle tasks through a familiar mobile-style interface.
prototypes.notes: Standalone HTML prototype copied into this repository root; it opens alongside the dashboard.

prototypes.name: Advocate Workflow Guidance Tool
prototypes.description: Static browser-based decision support for verification, investigation, resolution, documentation, and call closure.
prototypes.problem: Advocates navigate multiple knowledge articles and tools, increasing handling time and creating inconsistent resolution approaches.
prototypes.status: Source repository found; verify live URL
prototypes.notes: The repository has GitHub Pages enabled. The candidate URL is based on its repository name; deployment response has not yet been confirmed.

prototypes.name: Cash App Advocate Workflow Tool
prototypes.description: Browser-based workflow guidance platform with shared verification, decision-tree flows, recommendations, and knowledge references.
prototypes.problem: Support advocates need one place to follow complex procedures and locate the right tools, references, and verification steps.
prototypes.notes: No confirmed public deployment URL was identified. The prototype remains accessible via its source repository.
